key_concepts: Standard SI units are used for physical quantities
Length, mass, time, volume, and temperature are measurable physical quantities
Meter sticks and tape measures measure length
Balances measure mass and stopwatches measure time
Graduated cylinders measure volume and thermometers measure temperature
Accurate measurement requires appropriate laboratory tools rather than informal units like
Data from investigations can be organized using tables and graphs
A solution forms when a solute dissolves in a solvent
The solute is the dissolved substance and the solvent dissolves the solute
Solutions are homogeneous mixtures with uniform appearance
Solutions have practical importance to humans
